# Verified leaderboards

The game reads server-verified top-five boards for every bundled timed course and Endless, separately for each physics preset. One account has at most one ranked personal best on a board. Timed courses rank fastest first; Endless ranks longest distance first on a shared route.

Only server simulation outcomes can create entries. A result outside the top five does not write an entry. Ties keep the existing record. Usernames come from authenticated account profiles.

The text files in this folder are archived historical records. The game does not fetch, display or submit them. Editing them does not affect the verified leaderboards.
